promises.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

reported.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth.
If you look at the value, the decorative value has grown at a very good pitch of about 16.6%, albeit on a lower base.
possibly a weighted price increase of about 6.8% or so of what is captured in it.
New products within the portfolio contribute 17% of our overall revenues.
The top line has been about 13% growth of what we have achieved.
We have got a strong PBT growth of about 5%.
The PBT margins have been a little bit stressed here, about 15.7%, lower by 119 bps.
21% is the overall growth of what we have been able to do.
Therefore, the PBT margins are about 6.9% for the quarter, a little bit lower than what we had achieved on a YoY basis.
This has yielded results. We have grown at about 27% in Q1.
That's something which is a good story, which comes in with a PBT margin of about 7.9%, which is higher by 275 bps.
There was some pressure on gross margin; we were at about 45.6% in the last quarter.
In summary, if you look at the standalone financials, overall top line growth of about 17%.
Also looking at the overall growth which has come in, the bottom line has also been very strong and healthy.
Consolidated financials almost follow the same route. In fact, it improved to about an 18% top line growth.
